identitySignals: Name matches: Alameda County Behavioral Health (ACBHD), a department of Alameda County Health, listed under the county's official websites.
Located in Alameda County, CA (headquarters in Oakland), matching the agenda location.

profile.summary: Alameda County Behavioral Health is the county government department that provides mental health and substance use services to Alameda County residents. It mainly serves people with Medi-Cal or no insurance who have moderate to severe needs. Its Children's Specialized Services program provides mental health services to special education students.

review.notes: The cited county pages identify the Alameda County Health Behavioral Health Department at 2000 Embarcadero Cove, Suite 400, Oakland, phone (510) 567-8100. They describe it serving Medi-Cal and uninsured residents with moderate to severe needs, and its Children's Specialized Services program provides educationally-related mental health services to special education students, which fits OUSD's special education contract. The fetched page text left out that program description, but the same page's indexed content shows it, so every field is supported and the summary is neutral.
